jobs.title: Principal GSI Partner Manager - Accenture (EMEA)
Support Engineer, PAYGO
jobs.description:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Thousands of developers and companies use Exa on pay-as-you-go. As the Support Engineer for PAYGO, you own all of their inbound questions: getting started, search quality, billing, errors, integrations, and real bugs. The volume is high and every day is different.

It's one of the fastest ways to learn Exa end to end. You'll work with our AI support tools, the docs, Product and Engineering, and you'll see what developers build with Exa before anyone else does. Some of the people writing in are tomorrow's biggest customers, and you'll be the one who spots them.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the PAYGO queue: answer what the AI first line can't, quickly and clearly

  • Debug with customers: reproduce issues with the API, read their code and send working fixes

  • Triage well: production issues and unhappy customers first, everything else in order

  • Escalate with full context: bugs to Engineering, product gaps to Product, and anything you can't resolve to the Support leader

  • Spot growth: flag PAYGO accounts that look like future enterprise customers to Sales

  • Improve the AI first line: fix the docs, help center and agent workflows so the same question doesn't need a human twice

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback

Requirements

  • Programming experience: you can read unfamiliar code, call an API and debug a failing request

  • Clear, short writing. Customers can act on your answers without coming back

  • You learn fast and keep quality high when the volume is high

  • Good judgment on what to answer yourself and what to escalate

  • Comfort working AI-first, with AI tools and agents as part of your daily workflow

  • Early-career candidates are welcome

You might excel if you...

  • Have worked in support, developer relations or a customer-facing technical role at a developer-tools, API or AI company

  • Have built side projects with LLMs, RAG or agents

  • Enjoy being the person who finally figures out what's going on

  • Want to grow into an FDE or Solutions Architect role over time

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is a remote role based in the US. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Compensation: $115K – $225K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Growth Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About viral.app

viral.app is the software brands and agencies use to run UGC marketing at scale. It helps to hire creators, track every video on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, and pay creators based on performance.

So far the founders have run marketing alongside everything else: SEO and content, free tools, our newsletter The FYP Leak, Google Ads, and posts on LinkedIn and X. Tracking and a lot of the scrappy growth work already run on AI automations we built ourselves. We're hiring a Growth Lead for the channels and content that don't automate well and need skill and taste.

This is a hands-on role. You set the plan and do most of the work together with the founders.

Your tasks

  • Own growth end to end: the plan, the budget and the execution.

  • Build a niche audience around creator marketing on LinkedIn and X under your own name. If you already have one, bring it. If you don't, you're motivated to build it from zero.

  • Create the content formats that are hard to automate, for example short-form video, customer stories, founder-led posts and deep dives on what makes UGC perform.

  • Test and run any channel that could bring us customers, for example LinkedIn, X, YouTube, cold email, Google Ads, Meta ads, organic content, AEO (getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews), Reddit, affiliate marketing and B2B creators. Spend most of your time on the channels where quality beats volume.

  • For paid channels, run the ad accounts yourself: targeting, copy, creative briefs and budget.

  • Run experiments every week. Measure them against signups, trials and revenue, and keep what works.

  • Work with the founders and engineering on positioning, launches, onboarding and pricing pages.

  • Bring in freelancers or agencies where they're faster, and help build a growth team as we grow.

What success looks like after 90 days

  • You've launched at least two content formats we couldn't have automated, and our audience shares them.

  • You've found at least one organic and one paid channel that bring in signups week after week.

  • You post on LinkedIn and X every week, and your audience in creator marketing is growing.

  • Experiments ship every week, and each one ends with a written result.

  • We have a growth plan for the next six months that you wrote and own.

Your profile

  • About 3 years in B2B SaaS growth or marketing, with results you can show in numbers: signups, pipeline or ARR. Fewer years are fine if your results stand out.

  • You've grown a B2B SaaS product through organic channels such as SEO, content, community or product-led loops, and you did much of that work yourself.

  • You've run paid acquisition for B2B SaaS from inside the ad accounts. You know what CAC and payback should look like for a self-serve plan compared with a sales-assisted deal.

  • You've owned several channels at once, from first idea to live campaign to reporting.

  • You move fast. You'd rather ship five small tests this week than one perfect campaign next quarter.

  • You're scrappy. You write the landing page, build the campaign and pull the numbers yourself, and you know where AI saves time and where it hurts quality.

  • You have taste. You can tell a post, video or landing page that will land from one that won't, and you can make the good one yourself.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

Nice to have

  • An existing audience of marketers, founders or creators on LinkedIn or X

  • Experience with creator, UGC or influencer marketing, or with selling to performance marketers and agencies

  • Early-stage startup experience, ideally as the first marketing or growth hire

  • You've used free tools or data reports as a growth channel

What we offer

  • You own growth and report directly to the CEO.

  • €40,000–80,000 per year, depending on experience. Virtual stock options (VSOP) are possible for the right person.

  • A budget for ads and tools.

  • Fully remote from anywhere in a European time zone, with in-person team meetups several times a year.

  • Short decision paths. If a test makes sense, you can run it the same week.

How to apply

Apply with your CV and answer four short questions. Add links to real work in your application: pages you ranked, campaigns, dashboards or writing. They tell us more than a cover letter.

jobs.description:
Project Bay ist der erste CoWorking-Living Space mit direktem Meerzugang und neuer Hotspot für Innovation im Norden. Die Themen „Digitalisierung, Künstliche Intelligenz und neue Mobilitätslösungen“ werden hierbei mit regionaler Community, Work-Life-Balance und Natur pur verbunden.

Wir bieten unseren Kunden Büro- und CoWorking-Flächen, Break-Out-Optionen sowie Fortbildungen, Freizeitangebote und Übernachtungen direkt am Meer auf Rügen. Des Weiteren verfügen wir über einen Accelerator "Founders Bay", um junge Startups mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit zu unterstützen.

Ab sofort sind wir auch im Aufbau des ersten MakerSpaces auf der Insel Rügen. Neben digitalen Lösungen ist es notwendig auch einen Ort für Hardware-Lösungen zu schaffen.

Mit den Synergien unseres neuen Accelerators für nachhaltige Startups und den Kooperationen zu den Hochschulen, Kammern usw., möchten wir mit dem MakerSpace einen Ort für Handwerk, Selbstständige, Kreative und Startups schaffen.

Aufgaben

  • Fokusthema: Marketing - Du wirst gemeinsam mit uns den Bereich Marketing für B2B-Kunden sowie B2C-Strategien entwickeln mit Fokus auf Google- & Meta-Ads.

  • Du schreibst eigenständig SEO-optimierte Artikel für unsere Website, um unsere Community auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten

  • Du erstellst und versendest unseren Newsletter an die Community
  • Du entwickelst und erweiterst unsere Community

  • Du überwachst unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, analysierst KPIs, bereitest (Kampagnen-) Reports auf und entwickelst darauf basierende Handlungsempfehlungen
  • Du entdeckst Trends und Zielgruppen-relevante Themen
  • Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von vielen spannenden Marketing-Themen je nach Geschäftslage
  • Du fungierst als Kommunikationsschnittstelle zwischen der Geschäftsleitung und externen Geschäftspartnern sowie Mitarbeitern in deutscher und englischer Sprache.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften, Design (oder Vergleichbares) abgeschlossen
  • Erfahrung mit dem Meta-Ad Manager
  • Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Social Media und Online Marketing gesammelt und kennst die relevanten Plattformen

  • Du kannst schnell lernen und mit viel Eigeninitiative agieren, arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld und übernimmst Verantwortung
  • Du sprichst fließend deutsch und englisch und bist sicher im Verfassen von Texten
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer, engagiert, offen und kommunikativ

Benefits

    Marketing-Kampagnen zu bestimmen
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Kommunikationswege in einem hoch motivierten und kreativen Team
